nodes.title: Google Ads Search Certification
nodes.description: Designing and optimizing Google Search campaigns. Keyword research, bidding strategies, and performance tracking. Mapping semantic reach to digital marketing standards.

nodes.title: SHRM Certified Professional (SHRM-CP)
nodes.description: HR expertise: Leadership, Navigation, Ethical Practice, and Relationship Management. Mapping Ubuntu collective psychology to professional HR standards.

nodes.title: NCCER Core: Introduction to Basic Construction
nodes.description: Basic safety, construction math, hand tools, power tools, blueprints, and rigging. The foundational standard for all craft trades.

nodes.title: PTCB Pharmacy Technician (CPhT)
nodes.description: Medication safety, pharmacy law, and quality assurance. Linking phytochemistry and bioregional vitality to clinical pharmacy standards.

nodes.title: ASE G1: Maintenance and Light Repair
nodes.description: Automotive service excellence. Engine systems, automatic transmission, manual drive train, suspension, brakes, and electrical. Linked to the Mk0 Motor Teardown track.

nodes.title: CIPS Level 2 Certificate: Procurement & Supply
nodes.description: Core principles of sourcing and supply chain. Understanding the value of procurement in decentralized economies. Linked to the Mycelial Oracle track.
